_help: Each source is a Google News search (type: gnews, with a query), a direct RSS feed (type: rss, with a url), a Ministry of Education WordPress site (type: wpdocs, url = site root). section: govt | news | research | global. Add or remove entries freely. State-level stories are intentionally excluded (see TAGGING.md). Global = school-education reports, policy briefs and research only (no country news): direct feeds first, then targeted searches of each organisation's own site. windowDays = how far back a source looks (seen items are never repeated).
_nationalNewsHelp: News & Opinion only keeps items from these national outlets (subdomains included). City or regional editions (URLs with /city/, /cities/, a city name in Tribune links, etc.) are dropped too. Add or remove outlets freely.
